ASSET_MANAGER_CONCEPT.md v3, section 5 rendered. Content is the owner's real catalog on 2026-09-14: six local projects, seven gallery copies.

Projects panel, three widths

The same panel docked wide, docked medium, and docked narrow. The navigator sits beside the browser, the Inspector moves from a right column to a bottom band to a one-line strip, and nothing is scaled down: structure collapses, cards keep the size the user picked. Frames are drawn in the app's dark theme with its Inter 12 dp scale; the values use JetBrains Mono as the design language prescribes.

Navigator beside the browser. Library, Folders and Gallery are three headings in one column; attention counts ride on the rows as amber badges instead of being a scope of their own.
Cards end where their text ends. Thumbnail 16:10, one name line, one meta line with size and the gallery state. The selected card gets the accent edge and tint; the primary action lives in the Inspector, one click away.
Inspector on the right. Header with the name, path and the two verbs that matter now; four collapsible sections, values in mono. Operations puts every file action in one row: resume, versions, reduce size (prune checkpoints, drop an embedded dataset, compact), embed dataset, export as a format, update the thumbnail, license. Never a full-width thumbnail.
Everything resizes. Navigator width, Inspector width or height, tray height, list columns and the thumbnail size each have a visible handle, a minimum, a maximum and a remembered value; a double click on a handle restores the default.
Transfers tray. A footer that exists only while something moves: the most relevant transfer, speed, time left, a count, Pause, Show all. The separate Transfers window is gone.

State system: two axes and one flag

Gallery relationship

In gallery linked, equal
Changes here local ahead, offers Publish changes
Changes in gallery gallery ahead, offers Download
Conflict both changed, offers Resolve
Gallery only no local file, offers Download
Removed from gallery link kept, offers Publish again
Not in gallery no glyph at all

Activity, replaces the glyph while it runs

Preparing, Uploading 43%, Processing, Downloading 43% progress bar under the meta line and in the tray
❚❚Paused offers Resume
×Failed reason in the tooltip and the Inspector, offers Retry

File health, independent flag

!Missing offers Locate
!Replaced by another project offers Use this file or Locate original
!Unreadable, Needs repair offers Verify or Repair
!Saved by a newer version no action, update the app
Needs attention is a count. Conflict, Failed, Missing, Removed, Replaced, Unreadable and Needs repair add up to the amber badge on All projects and Published, and to one filter chip. It is never a place with an empty table.
Words with every glyph. The grid shows the glyph plus a short label; the list and the Inspector show the full label and the reason. No state is color-only.

Later
One dialog for conflicts. The existing conflict groups (title, view settings, camera track, scene content, visibility) become rows with a Mine / Gallery / Both choice. Nothing is silently overwritten.
The overwrite case gets a real answer. Today this state is a red cloud with a "Refresh" button that talks to the portal. In the concept the Library replaces the entry and asks the only question that matters.
